root_cause: Independent Netlify logs following protected #4909 show 2-3 growth-drain invocations per minute. Mixed runs persist 3-4 events and register 3-7 indexPointerInvalid but zero indexSourceMissing/providerFailed. A list() snapshot key may be deleted by another invocation before get(); code previously collapsed a valid null result into malformed-pointer failure. This is a probable race, not proof that every pointer is corrupt.
fix: Treat a successful null indexed pointer read as concurrent completed retirement, no false-green provider outcome; separately count indexPointerGone. Treat malformed non-null pointer, missing original, and provider get exceptions as distinct remaining integrity errors, emitting HTTP503 and retaining evidence. Same scheduler and original source receipt retention.

prevention_rules: A successfully missing disposable index pointer after list() is an expected concurrent-retirement race
A thrown provider read is NOT a missing pointer and remains a visible integrity error
Never delete original source receipts or fabricate visitor conversion
Preserve backpressure, at-least-once idempotency and fail-closed real corruption
Do not add duplicate cron or parallel executor
Legacy fallback must exclude all pending/ disposable index records; otherwise provider exceptions are counted twice and snapshot races become false failures.
terminal_rule: Exact-head Required, CodeQL, Netlify, protected merge then provider logs showing indexPointerGone with no false 503 and independent events in Supabase; remaining genuine corruption and realized revenue must stay separately open.
